You are a fix worker on the OBE podcast repo. Your current working directory IS a git worktree of /mnt/d_drive/repos/podcast - edit files here directly. Do NOT git commit, branch, or push; leave changes uncommitted. No skills/MCP/network. PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1.

CONTEXT (live proof-run evidence, episode 2026-06-10-fred-cho): the full chain rendered a 1889.3s angle-switched program from a 2159s content window (~270s dead-air cut; editorial LLM soft-failed to no-cuts). The transfer gate (mode=av_anchors) failed with a drift PATTERN: anchor 0.4s -> -21.5ms ok; anchor 472.5s -> +103.5ms (audio_confidence 0.72); plus three anchors with audio_confidence 0.19-0.29 (below min 0.4) counted as failures. Review packet: episodes/_review_queue/20260723T112855-publishable-render-17bb0f.json (read it). DIAGNOSIS: (a) the transfer time map is built from PLANNED cut floats, but each rendered segment start/duration gets frame-snapped at encode (~33ms per boundary), so map error accumulates ~100ms mid-episode - the RENDER is fine, the map bookkeeping is approximate; (b) weak-confidence anchors are unmeasurable, not failing - counting them as failures is measurement noise, not substance. ALSO: the applied edit plan/cuts were not persisted into episode.json (no edit_plan/applied cut receipt found at top level) - receipt gap.

TASK: make the time map honest and the anchor policy sound.

OWNERSHIP: you own ONLY: server/pipeline/angle_render.py, server/pipeline/video_assembly.py, server/pipeline/media_gates.py, server/pipeline/orchestrator.py, tests/test_media_gates_integration.py, tests/test_keep_timeline.py, tests/test_orchestrator.py. Never modify anything else.

BUILD:
1. TRUE-BOUNDARY MAPS: wherever segments are rendered then concatenated (angle_render.render_angle_switch per-segment path AND video_assembly.apply_keep_timeline), ffprobe each rendered segment's ACTUAL duration after encode and build the edited->source time map cumulatively from those actual durations (source offsets stay the planned cut positions; edited offsets come from actual encoded lengths, including any crossfade overlap already handled). The map handed to validate_transfer must reflect real concat arithmetic, not planned floats.
2. ANCHOR POLICY in media_gates.validate_transfer (av_anchors mode): anchors with audio_confidence below min_audio_confidence are recorded as 'unmeasurable' in measurements and count NEITHER pass nor fail; the gate requires at least min_strong_anchors=3 measurable anchors and ALL measurable anchors within threshold; fewer than 3 measurable = FAIL('insufficient measurable anchors') - fail closed on unmeasurability of the WHOLE validation, tolerant of individual noisy anchors. Add param min_strong_anchors=3. When anchor count allows, prefer picking replacement anchor positions to reach 3 strong (probe a few extra candidate positions before giving up).
3. RECEIPT: persist the applied edit plan into episode.json at render time: {'edit_plan_receipt': {'cuts': [...applied with ids/kinds/spans...], 'total_cut_s', 'source_window': [start,end], 'renderer': 'angle_switch'|'keep_timeline', 'segment_boundaries': [...actual...]}} - the composition contract (every must_cut applied or halt) checks against THIS receipt; wire where _render_publishable_program returns.
4. Keep every strict downstream behavior otherwise unchanged; the CLI gates and their tests (tests/test_media_gates.py) stay untouched.

TESTS: (a) map fidelity - render 3 synthetic segments whose encoded durations differ from planned by ~30ms each (force with fps/keyframe constraints), assert the produced map matches ffprobe'd concat reality within 5ms at each boundary and validate_transfer passes; (b) anchor policy - fake measurements: 2 strong-pass + 2 weak -> FAIL insufficient; 3 strong-pass + 2 weak -> PASS with weak recorded unmeasurable; 3 strong with one failing -> FAIL; (c) receipt - after a render, episode.json carries edit_plan_receipt with actual segment_boundaries and the must-cut assertion reads it. ALL existing tests green (update those asserting planned-float maps; list them).

HOW TO RUN: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m pytest tests/test_media_gates_integration.py tests/test_keep_timeline.py tests/test_orchestrator.py tests/test_media_gates.py -q -p no:cacheprovider

OUTPUT CONTRACT: uncommitted changes + ./fix-summary.md ('# Fix Summary','## Summary','## Files Changed','## Verification','## Assumptions', <600 words).
